user_tools.planning_hint: Use for local GUI-driven FRAP workflows through a commercial external application window. This tool supports laser enable or disable actions, stage-coordinate-to-window coordinate mapping, and contour-derived targeting from the latest local image.
user_tools.execution_hint: This tool is a local GUI adapter, not a hardware SDK. It requires a visible FRAP application window and a valid frap_ui_profile.json in the output directory. Use laser_position only when the laser is off.

user_tools.planning_hint: Use for direct MP-285A USB-VCP manipulator control on COM3. Positions are in microns and the tool manages the underlying microstep conversion.
user_tools.execution_hint: Connect before motion, prefer absolute moves, and reconfigure soft limits if the origin is changed.
